region.description: A region on the provider's allow-list. Fixed once the app is created.

teamId.description: Team that owns the app; optional

email.description: Address the invite link is sent to

role.description: Role granted on acceptance; OWNER cannot be invited

InviteDto.description: A pending or past invite. The signed token and the accept link are never part of any response.

info.description: Every endpoint returns an ApiResponse, or a PageResponse nested inside one for a paginated result; failures are rendered as an ErrorResponse by the platform's global exception handler.
info.title: Org Team Service

get.description: Public. Shows what an emailed invite link is for, so the accept page can render before the invitee signs up. The token is verified before anything is read; the invitee's email is masked.

parameters.description: Signed invite token from the invite email
parameters.name: token

400.description: INVALID_TOKEN: bad signature, expired or wrong purpose

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

get.description: Every organization the caller is an active member of, personal and team, with the caller's role in each. The personal organization comes first by default. Requires any signed-in account; no organization membership is involved, and the result is scoped to the caller alone.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

post.description: Creates a TEAM organization owned by the caller. The slug is derived from the name when omitted and must be unique across every organization. Requires any signed-in account; no organization membership is involved, and the result is scoped to the caller alone. Retrying conflicts (409) rather than creating a duplicate.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

delete.description: Soft-deletes a TEAM organization: every member is removed, pending invites are revoked and apps are deleted. Requires the OWNER, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles. Also requires a recent sign-in; a stale session is rejected with 403 REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED. The X-Confirm-Slug header must equal the organization's slug.

parameters.description: The organization's slug, repeated to confirm the deletion
parameters.name: X-Confirm-Slug

400.description: CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: X-Confirm-Slug is missing or wrong

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_ROLE, NOT_A_MEMBER or REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED

409.description: PERSONAL_ORG_IMMUTABLE: a personal organization is never deleted here

get.description: Returns the organization with live member, team and app counts. Requires any active member of the organization, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles. An organization other than the caller's own is reported as 404 ORG_NOT_FOUND.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

patch.description: Changes the display name only; the slug and owner never change here. Requires ADMIN or above, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

get.description: Optionally filtered by team or cloud provider. Requires any active member of the organization, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

post.description: The cloud provider and region are chosen here and can never be changed. The region must be on the allow-list for the provider. Requires DEVELOPER or above, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles. Retrying conflicts (409) rather than creating a duplicate.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

delete.description: Soft delete; the app's slug becomes reusable. Requires ADMIN or above, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

get.description: Requires any active member of the organization, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

patch.description: Changes the name and the owning team only; sending null for teamId detaches the app. Any other field, including the cloud provider and region, is rejected with 400. Requires DEVELOPER or above, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

get.description: An invite past its expiry reads as EXPIRED even before the background sweep marks it. Requires ADMIN or above, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

post.description: Emails the invitee a single-use link. The token is never returned. An OWNER may grant ADMIN, DEVELOPER or VIEWER; an ADMIN only DEVELOPER or VIEWER; nobody may grant OWNER. Requires ADMIN or above, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles. Retrying conflicts (409) rather than creating a duplicate.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

409.description: ALREADY_A_MEMBER, MEMBER_PREVIOUSLY_REMOVED, INVITE_ALREADY_PENDING, QUOTA_EXCEEDED or PERSONAL_ORG_IMMUTABLE

delete.description: Revocation stops the invite showing as pending. A link already emailed still verifies cryptographically; if it is used, the resulting account is disabled shortly afterwards. Requires ADMIN or above, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

post.description: Issues a fresh link with a new expiry for the same invite. Subject to a cooldown between sends and a maximum send count. Requires ADMIN or above, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles. Retrying conflicts (409) rather than creating a duplicate.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

get.description: Active members by default. Filtering on status REMOVED requires ADMIN or above. Sortable by displayName, joinedAt and role; any other sort field is a 400 INVALID_SORT. Requires any active member of the organization, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

delete.description: The owner may remove anyone but themselves; an ADMIN may remove DEVELOPER and VIEWER members; any member may remove themselves. The owner cannot be removed or leave: transfer ownership first. Removing an already-removed member is a 404. Requires any active member of the organization, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles. Further limits depend on the target's role.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

delete.summary: Remove a member or leave the organization

get.description: Requires any active member of the organization, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

patch.description: Sets the role to ADMIN, DEVELOPER or VIEWER. The owner cannot be targeted and OWNER cannot be assigned here; use transfer-ownership. Setting the current role is a 200 with no change. Requires the OWNER, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

post.description: The target becomes OWNER and the caller becomes ADMIN in one transaction. The target must be an active member. Requires the OWNER, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles. Also requires a recent sign-in; a stale session is rejected with 403 REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED. A retry after success is rejected because the caller is no longer the owner; it does not transfer twice.

403.description: INSUFFICIENT_ROLE, NOT_A_MEMBER or REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED

get.description: Returns the caller's current role, so a client needs no token-claim parsing. Requires any active member of the organization, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource

get.description: Requires any active member of the organization, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles.

delete.description: Detaches the team's apps and removes its member assignments; the members stay in the organization. Requires ADMIN or above, judged from your current membership, not your token's roles.
